reason: A mobile access setup plugin for DeepSeek Harness that detects local and Tailscale connectivity, supports QR-based pairing, offers direct or HTTP/2 access modes, and provides an insecure-origin compatibility patch.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供移动端接入设置，包括局域网与 Tailscale 检测、离线二维码配对、直连或 HTTP/2 连接切换及兼容补丁。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness mobile access setup with LAN and Tailscale detection, offline QR pairing, direct or HTTP/2 connection switching, and a compatibility patch.

capabilities: Detects Tailscale and LAN network information
Generates offline QR codes for mobile pairing
Creates, expires, registers, and revokes pairing tokens
Toggles Tailscale Serve HTTP/2 mode and probes reachability
Can inject a crypto.randomUUID compatibility polyfill into index.html
Provides firewall command guidance and may invoke Tailscale operations requiring user elevation
